description: This file defines the CityPickerActivity class, an Android activity responsible for allowing users to select a city from a list, filter the list via a search box, and persist the selected city in preferences.

classes.name: CityPickerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of cities for selection, supports filtering via search, and updates preferences with the selected city.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, loads city data, and configures search filtering.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters the city list based on the search query and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes pending callbacks to avoid memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
